# Rename: stardict -> opendict

Lib crate name changes from `stardict` to `opendict`. Package/module names follow.
Everything that refers to the StarDict **format** (the dictionary type) stays as-is.

## Rule of thumb

- `stardict::DictKind::StarDict` — KEEP (refers to the format)
- `StarDictDictionary`, `stardict_strcmp`, `src/stardict/` module — KEEP (format)
- `"StarDict's dict ifo file"` magic string — KEEP (format spec)
- `tests/dicts/stardict/` paths — KEEP (directory of StarDict-format files)
- `extern crate stardict`, `use stardict::`, package names — CHANGE (refers to our crate)

## 9. node/index.js (napi-rs generated)

Global find-and-replace in this file only:

| find | replace |
|------|---------|
| `stardict.android-arm64` | `opendict.android-arm64` |
| `stardict-android-arm64` | `opendict-android-arm64` |
| (same pattern for every platform triple) | |

Effectively two replacements:
- `'./stardict.` → `'./opendict.` (local .node files)
- `'stardict-` → `'opendict-` (npm optional-dep packages)
- `'stardict-wasm32-wasi'` → `'opendict-wasm32-wasi'`
- `'./stardict.wasi.cjs'` → `'./opendict.wasi.cjs'`

**Easiest approach**: just re-run `napi build --platform --release` after updating `node/package.json` — napi-rs regenerates `index.js` from the napi name.

## 10. node/index.d.ts

Empty file — will be regenerated by napi build. No manual change needed.

## 17. expo/ios/stardict_mobileFFI.h -> expo/ios/opendict_mobileFFI.h

Rename file. Contents contain generated FFI symbols — all `stardict_mobile` prefixes in function names become `opendict_mobile`. This file is regenerated by uniffi, so just rebuild after renaming the mobile crate.

## 18. expo/ios/stardict_mobile.swift -> expo/ios/opendict_mobile.swift

Rename file. This is uniffi-generated — all `stardict_mobile` / `stardictMobile` symbols change to `opendict_mobile` / `opendictMobile`. Regenerate by rebuilding the mobile crate with uniffi after the Cargo.toml rename.

## 21. Tests — extern crate + use

All test files use `extern crate stardict` and `use stardict::...` to refer to the **crate** (not the internal stardict format module). Change all of these.

### tests/integration.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::dictionary::Dictionary;
+ use opendict::dictionary::Dictionary;
```

### tests/dict.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::dict::{Dict, DictEntry};
+ use opendict::dict::{Dict, DictEntry};
```

### tests/syn.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::syn::{Syn, SynEntry};
+ use opendict::syn::{Syn, SynEntry};
```

### tests/idx.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::idx::{Idx, IdxEntry};
+ use opendict::idx::{Idx, IdxEntry};
```

### tests/strcmp.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::strcmp::stardict_strcmp;
+ use opendict::strcmp::stardict_strcmp;
```

Note: `stardict_strcmp` is the **function name** (refers to the StarDict format's comparison algorithm) — it stays.

### tests/ifo.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::ifo::Ifo;
+ use opendict::ifo::Ifo;
```

### tests/real_dicts.rs

```rust
- extern crate stardict;
+ extern crate opendict;
```

```rust
- use stardict::dictionary::Dictionary;
+ use opendict::dictionary::Dictionary;
```

Every `stardict::open(` and `stardict::DictKind::` call (crate-level):

```rust
- let dict = stardict::open(dir.clone(), stardict::DictKind::MDict);
+ let dict = opendict::open(dir.clone(), opendict::DictKind::MDict);
```

```rust
- let dict = stardict::open(dir, stardict::DictKind::StarDict).ok()?;
+ let dict = opendict::open(dir, opendict::DictKind::StarDict).ok()?;
```

(Apply to all ~8 occurrences of `stardict::open` and `stardict::DictKind` in this file.)
